title: TaxKit Docs Application Architecture Implementation Tasks
principles: Treat TDA-001 through TDA-007 as accepted required findings and preserve TDA-P01 through TDA-P05 in every affected slice.
Keep TDA-008 search deferred: name packages/docs-content as the future policy owner without adding search code.
This is a package reshaping and application-boundary migration, not a greenfield scaffold, Fumadocs UI adoption, shared UI package or public-copy rewrite.
Keep installed TanStack Start, TanStack Router, Fumadocs, Effect, React, Vite and Nitro versions; do not edit bun.lock for dependency changes.
Decode generic and generated representations once at the owning ingress, expose schema-derived values and safe tagged errors, and encode route transport explicitly.
Keep Effects flat and lazy; packages define services and Layers, while the app composes and executes the server runtime.
Keep route restoration and outcome policy in routes, coordination in app-owned containers, and presentation leaves service-free and runtime-free.
Reject generic callback/raw-client escape hatches, pass-through hooks, common/utils sprawl and barrels without an admitted semantic owner and focused proof.
Keep local package, HTTP, built-app and browser proof distinct from deployment, publication, provider and public-site claims.

Retain a bounded screenshot manifest and required images for the exact final candidate, but never substitute visual evidence for HTTP, hydration, request-trace, accessibility, motion, contrast or console oracles.

globalVerification.commitPolicy: Create an active execution plan when DOCS-APP-001 begins. Any implementation, generated-content, dependency or build-config change invalidates the set and requires a new candidate and recapture. Stop between tasks when an accepted architecture boundary becomes impossible without an upgrade or scope expansion. Push, versioning, tagging, publication, deployment and provider mutation remain out of scope.

downstreamArtifactImpact.acceptance: All canonical owners describe package-owned content, the generic Fumadocs service, app execution and claim-matched built proof without duplicating implementation procedure.
Each README names its exact target responsibility, entrypoints, commands, runtime boundary and proof limitations.
Affected architecture owners contain the target graph; existing standards remain preserved unless an observed gap requires the smallest clarification.
No operational procedure, environment, credential, deployment or provider action changes; current runbook and authority controls remain untouched.

The repository owns separate deterministic package, built HTTP, hydration, browser, 404, navigation and accessibility oracles. Transient build directories, videos, traces, logs and unbounded/raw browser output are not committed; the only retained browser artifacts are the bounded DAR-013 manifest and PNG set, carried by the evidence-only closeout commit and moved with the plan from active to completed.
The repository-local docs profile routes the new public roots and commands; AGENTS, the canonical skill implementation and relative skill link remain preserved.
Generation and all docs workspaces are reachable in development/production checks; canonical verification and the existing Quality workflow inherit the focused changes exactly once.

An active plan exists only during implementation; final SPEC/tasks/index and plan lifecycle agree after every accepted finding and proof row is complete. The bounded screenshot directory moves with the plan to completed and names the exact clean implementation candidate.

Accepted, missing, malformed, server/browser import and built-app scenarios exercise the same public contracts used by production. Pending and error visual fixtures are deterministic test-only composition inputs, not production routes, flags or a generic scenario framework.
Source/type/default exports, generated owners and app build inputs match the target graph.
Content, frontmatter status, navigation taxonomy and examples relocate without copy changes; exact acceptance bindings and public lifecycle semantics remain valid at their new paths.

Every task compares its final manifest/lock diff to the target revision and rejects dependency additions or upgrades; an unavoidable installed-compatibility blocker stops for a separate accepted SPEC.
DOCS-APP-001 proves path-normalized content equality and existing validation after relocation; copy, status, taxonomy and information architecture are not rewritten.
One patch Changeset records both private package contract changes; task boundaries support normal Git rollback, while versioning, tagging, publication and deployment remain excluded.

The docs journey distinguishes content validation, built SSR, hydration, internal client navigation, HTTP 404, accessibility and console proof from deployment/public-site claims. Candidate-bound screenshots supplement those oracles and are never cited as proof of non-visual behavior.

TDA-008, the SPEC non-goals and authority limits exclude search, SEO, hosting, deployment and public-site proof; DOCS-APP-005 and DOCS-APP-006 retain a negative scope audit and do not edit an owner merely to restate the exclusion.
